result: Implemented the bounded Desktop WorkSurfaceProjection translation. Generated WorkstreamKey and AttachmentKey authority are required before a row becomes renderable; SessionId, InstanceId, and WorkSurfaceId are preserved under WorkSurfaceProjection.identity and legacy scalar fields are display-only copies. Legacy project_root/continuity_id rows are quarantined rather than repaired, exact-scope keys are unavailable for incomplete identities, and Core remains the owner of eligibility, layout, recomposition, revisions, and operation authority.

eligible_contributions: generated Work Surface rows with explicit WorkstreamKey, AttachmentKey, and WorkSurfaceId
presentation_contract.agent_tui_boundary: The Agent TUI remains the separate authentic PTY-backed Pi terminal and is not used as the Mission Canvas renderer.

checks: npm --prefix apps/desktop test (exit 0; shell, Desktop context, layout/renderer, transport, projection controller, exact identity translation, quarantine, stale watermark, omission, race, and hostile response checks: PASS)
additional_checks: npm --prefix apps/desktop run check (exit 1; pre-existing unrelated GeneratedSurfaceContribution.svelte import cannot resolve @focusa/a2ui-renderer/rich-host; no diagnostic points to CORE-007 files; this is outside the packet validation command)

CORE-003.decision: Dependency source implementation is integrated. Its only recorded remainder is the explicitly prohibited Cargo runtime check; the generated projection authority and fail-closed Workstream validation needed by CORE-007 are available and its permitted checks pass.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: projectWorkSurfacesWithDiagnostics accepts an expected WorkstreamAuthorityContext and quarantines a valid row from another Workstream as foreign_scope; a mismatched AttachmentKey owner is quarantined as foreign_attachment_workstream.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Rows without an explicit generated WorkstreamKey and AttachmentKey, including legacy rows containing only project_root, continuity_id, attachment_id, session_id, and instance_id, produce no Desktop projection and are quarantined. An aggregate identity without AttachmentKey cannot produce an authority-bearing row.
negative_cases.stale_revision_cursor: The existing generated projection controller remains the revision/cursor boundary. The required npm test exercises projection revision regression, layout revision regression, cursor regression, cursor namespace mismatch, stale transport responses, and preservation of the last safe projection.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: Capability and operation eligibility remain Core-owned. Existing projection-controller/runtime coverage consumes the canonical omission and does not create a Work Surface or replacement contribution in Desktop.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Empty Work Rail content remains omitted before geometry; existing projection tests assert the omission diagnostic and absence from eligible contributions/layout. The new row translator performs no eligibility or layout resolution.
negative_cases.ambiguous_legacy_row: Legacy flat rows are quarantined with missing_exact_identity. Duplicate complete identities are also quarantined rather than selecting a first/nearest row. No project_root plus continuity_id fallback or current-tab inference was added.
negative_cases.identity_mismatch: Top-level WorkSurfaceId, InstanceId, SessionId, AttachmentId, workspace binding, continuity, runtime, and attachment metadata that disagree with WorkSurfaceProjection.identity are rejected as identity_mismatch.

acceptance.statement: Svelte cannot attach, focus, or steer a legacy Work Surface payload missing exact identity.
acceptance.proof: Only WorkSurfaceProjection rows carrying an exact generated identity with WorkstreamKey, AttachmentKey, SessionId, InstanceId, and WorkSurfaceId are emitted. Legacy rows have no identity and are quarantined; exactScopeKey returns undefined for them. Existing projection controller and operation transport tests fail closed on missing/foreign authority.

acceptance.statement: project_root plus continuity_id cannot bind or focus a Work Surface.
acceptance.proof: The translator never constructs WorkstreamKey or AttachmentKey from flat project/continuity fields. Authority-bearing scope comes only from generated identity/attachment fields, while the controller and generated transport validate exact Workstream scope before accepting a projection.

acceptance.statement: ambiguous legacy rows are quarantined, not guessed.
acceptance.proof: Missing, malformed, foreign, conflicting, and duplicate rows are excluded from the renderable result and receive bounded quarantine diagnostics. No fallback to CWD, latest row, selected tab, or nearest identity exists.

hostile_tests: generated WorkSurface payload projects exact WorkstreamKey, AttachmentKey, SessionId, InstanceId, and WorkSurfaceId
exactScopeKey is identical for a projection and its canonical identity and is absent for a legacy flat row
duplicate complete identities are both quarantined
projection revision/layout revision/cursor regressions remain stale
empty/ineligible Work Rail remains omitted and does not become a replacement panel
scope race and clear behavior preserve the newest exact binding

authority_preservation.composition_owner: Focusa Core ResolvedWorkspaceProjection eligibility/layout/recomposition and generated operation metadata
authority_preservation.desktop_boundary: Desktop validates and renders canonical payloads; it does not infer identity, eligibility, layout, operations, or authority.

source_authority.crates/focusa-core/src/mission_canvas/mo: read completely as canonical authority model
source_authority.docs/contracts/spec135/mission-canvas-v1: read completely as generated transport authority
source_authority.docs/spec158/03-client-runtime-and-deskt: read completely as Desktop boundary authority
